description: Run an AudioEye accessibility scan on the session's tab (or navigate it to `url` first). Returns the scan report as Markdown: failure counts and tables of failures by rule, with source links and selectors. Every report is also saved to `.agent/a11y-scans/<session>/scan-<n>.md` and the result always links it; a report too long for the chat is replaced by a short header with that link. Every scan is saved in full to `scan-<n>.json` beside it, and the result always links that file too: read it for component keys, file paths, rule metadata and `sourceFixGuidance`. Do NOT re-emit the scan via a Write tool yourself. Present it to the user verbatim: never reformat or rebuild the tables, and never build an HTML page, artifact, or custom UI for scan results unless the user explicitly asks for a different format. When the user asked a pointed question, answer it directly — but any tabular summary you show must be this report, verbatim. Keep the Source cells as the links given: IDE hosts open the file at that line; in a terminal the absolute `filePath` in the linked scan JSON, present only when the source resolved to a workspace file, is Cmd+clickable.

forceReload.description: When true, reload the page before scanning. Default: false — a matching `url` (or omitted `url`) scans the existing DOM without reloading. Use this only when the `staleMutatedDom` diagnostic told you a prior scan lost source mapping due to DOM mutation, OR when the user explicitly asks for a fresh page state. Do NOT pass this just because the user said "scan again" — that should scan the current state.

inspector.description: Overrides the `inspector` config key for this scan: `false` skips injecting the in-page inspector panel, `true` forces it in any headful Chrome (the panel goes only in the tab this session opened); headless browsers never get it. When the panel is left off, the scan report says why. The in-page payload is injected once per tab and re-applied on every navigation, so the override applies on the first scan of that tab; to change it, close the browser and scan again.

runOptions.description: Partial AudioEye SDK RunOptions. Sensible defaults applied.

url.description: Optional URL to load in the session's tab before scanning. If omitted, scans the session's tab as is.

viewport.description: CSS-pixel viewport to set on the scanned tab before navigating and scanning, e.g. `{ width: 390, height: 844 }`. It stays on that tab for later scans.

waitForReadyMs.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for the page before scanning (default 5000); a cap, not a fixed delay. The scan starts sooner, once the body shows text or media and no network request has been in flight for 500 ms. The saved scan JSON records `waitedMs`.

name: audioeye_scan
title: Run an accessibility scan
